AI_API_KEY.description: Required AI provider API key. Add it as a Cloudflare Worker secret or provide it in gateway/.env.cloudflare.local.

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional Google OAuth client ID used by the identity verifier.

GATEWAY_TOKEN.description: Optional legacy gateway token; use a high-entropy value and store it only as a Cloudflare Worker secret.

GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL.description: Google Play service-account email for purchase verification.

GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Google Play service-account private key for purchase verification; keep it only in Cloudflare Worker secrets.

PUBSUB_PUSH_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL.description: Expected Google service-account email for authenticated Play RTDN Pub/Sub pushes.

PUBSUB_PUSH_AUDIENCE.description: HTTPS audience configured on the authenticated Play RTDN Pub/Sub push subscription.

PLAY_PACKAGE_NAME.description: Android application package name used by Google Play purchase verification.

PLAY_SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_IDS.description: Comma-separated Google Play subscription product IDs accepted by the gateway.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Resend API key used for sending verification and password reset emails. Keep it only in Cloudflare Worker secrets.

RESEND_FROM_EMAIL.description: Optional sender address for Resend, e.g. 'WristBrief <auth@yourdomain.com>'. Defaults to 'WristBrief <onboarding@resend.dev>'.
